verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents in-app widgets as part of its feedback portal, and its featurebase-js SDK claims a four-line install. However, that SDK is framed around the messenger and framework imports, and nothing in the evidence shows a single script-tag embed with no build step. missing for 10: documented single script-tag embed snippet for the feedback widget, explicit no-build-step/no-bundler installation path, feedback-widget-specific embed docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed a feedback widget on my website with a single script tag and no build step

citations.quote: Centralize insights to a single source of truth with a feedback portal, in-app widgets, and integrations.
Install, boot, and start chatting with users in four lines.
